programs.title: Classic Car Rescue Germany
programs.desc: Chris and Max work every day at the Kubicki Motors workshop.The gentlemen are specialists in finding and restoring classic cars and youngtimers.

programs.title: Tunnelbanan 8
programs.desc: Security guards and staff ensure the safety and smooth operation of the Stockholm Metro.They catch thieves and help passengers in trouble.

programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The team that is carrying the 200-ton reactor from Lithuania to Belarus has to face extremely difficult weather conditions.The main driver, Makuwa, faces snow-covered roads and cooperation with local pilots that leaves much to be desired.A team of specialist roadside assistance sets out to deal with the breakdown of a dump truck going to collect coal.He needs to unblock the narrow two-way road before it creates a traffic jam.After waiting for 24 hours at the border, Tomek, Ania and Mateusz enter Germany.However, they are forced to take a longer route, and the transport is interrupted by a failure of the trailer's lighting and controls.Finally, they come across a viaduct that is too low.

programs.title: Mighty Truckers
programs.desc: The series tells the story of representatives of not the easiest profession - drivers of large-size vehicles.It involves long working hours, frequent fatigue, huge loads, and busy roads.These are just selected obstacles that truckers struggle with every day.However, they do not complain.On the contrary, they love their job and would not change it for any other.Now they will tell themselves where the passion for covering subsequent sections of European roads comes from: in Germany, Italy and the Netherlands.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: This season, car enthusiasts Mike Brewer and Marc "Elvis" Priestley are once again hunting for engines and parts from iconic cars to give them a second life.
